title: Matar Pulao (Peas Pulao)
tagline: A quick, everyday one-pot of basmati and sweet green peas with whole spices.
intro: Matar pulao is the weeknight hero of South Asian kitchens — basmati and green peas tempered with cumin and whole spices, cooked in a single pot. It's light, fragrant and ready in half an hour, pairing beautifully with almost any curry or simply a bowl of yoghurt.

items: 400 g (2 cups) basmati rice, soaked 20 min
200 g (1½ cups) green peas (fresh or frozen)
1 cinnamon stick, 3 cloves, 3 cardamom, 1 bay leaf

method: Heat the oil and add cumin seeds and whole spices until fragrant.
Add the onion and fry until light golden. Add ginger–garlic paste and green chillies.
Add the peas and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the drained rice and stir gently to coat. Add the water and salt.
Bring to a boil, then cover and cook on low until the water is absorbed and the rice is fluffy, about 12–15 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
tips: A 1:1.75 rice-to-water ratio (by volume) gives perfectly separate grains.
Frozen peas can go in straight from the freezer.
toServe: Great with any dal, korma or raita.
